scoring.subsegment_note: Subsegments are diagnostics within one temporal window and are not independent timeline votes.

full_versus_capped.candidate_selection_effect: not established: coarse FFT candidate generation is independent of the score cap, but production requested-rate refinement selects among nearby corrections with the capped scorer; this experiment scored full overlap only at already selected candidates and did not rerun that refinement neighborhood
full_versus_capped.interpretation: The cap is threshold-material for isolated rows, including production-mono comparison-2 window 2. It does not rescue comparison-2 windows 3-5 under the measured production path, but a full-overlap rerun of the requested-rate refinement neighborhood is required before claiming candidate selection is unchanged.

timings.note: Per-condition feature/search/scoring values are recorded in scoring rows; sums are component timings and need not equal wall time.

findings.1_comparison_1_weak_tail: Yes. R6A correctly rejected the tail rather than converting it to zero: the mono tail is only 6.7667% active at -75 dBFS, FL/FR/FC are below 5%, candidate lags are unstable across views/bands/subsegments, and PHAT or FR zero-lag identity is a quiet-content artifact, not edit evidence.
findings.2_comparison_2_failure_stage: Waveform confidence, not candidate generation. Raw FFT repeatedly found 93-99 samples (5.8125-6.1875 ms, zero frames) in all five windows, including the three rejected windows; their production-mono capped scores were 0.605872, 0.702007, and 0.735325.
findings.3_mono_cancellation: Production mono materially degrades the match, but literal phase cancellation is not isolated. The weak-window FL scores were 0.930760, 0.979977, and 0.905623 while mono was 0.605872, 0.702007, and 0.735325. FFmpeg also used a lower surround coefficient for comparison 2, so mix/rematrix composition is a plausible contributor.
findings.4_corresponding_channels: Yes for comparison 2: FL, FR, and FC top candidates agree within 93-99 samples across all five windows. They are correlated views of one observation, not independent votes. Comparison 1's quiet tail contradicts across views and remains unassessed.
findings.5_full_overlap_vs_cap: The cap is threshold-material for isolated rows: production-mono comparison-2 window 2 is 0.908637 capped versus 0.884892 full. Coarse FFT generation is unaffected, but requested-rate refinement uses capped scores to choose among nearby corrections; because this experiment did not rerun that neighborhood with full-overlap scoring, its candidate-selection effect remains unassessed. The measured production path still leaves windows 3-5 below the fixed floor and does not alter the current evidence disposition.
findings.6_fixed_bands: No fixed band recovers all weak windows. Low 20-300 Hz raises window 4 to 0.969771 but collapses window 5 to 0.040924; speech/mid and upper/high remain below 0.90 on multiple windows, and upper/high reduces strong window 2 to 0.340999. Full usable bandwidth reproduces baseline.
findings.7_raw_fft_vs_phat: PHAT mostly changes peak shape and increases peak ratios; it does not improve recall because raw FFT already finds the stable comparison-2 lag in every window. PHAT moves window 4 from 94 to 99 samples with a lower waveform score and produces a misleading zero-lag quiet-tail candidate for comparison 1.
findings.8_rate_bandwidth: No meaningful confidence-disposition difference. Matching the 3.8 kHz bandwidth at 16 kHz modestly changes scores; 8 kHz adds only 1-sample grid shifts and still leaves comparison-2 windows 3-5 below 0.90. Production staging reproduces 16 kHz verification scores. Fewer collection phases explain runtime savings, not confidence recovery.
findings.9_decoder_rematrix_drc: Decoder identity and DRC are not supported causes: all use the same native E-AC-3 decoder and no explicit DRC option or timestamp repair. Rematrix metadata is a plausible contributor because comparison 2 uses different surround coefficients and direct corresponding channels match substantially better.
findings.10_existing_bounded_method: A single existing production setting is not sufficient globally: mono fails three windows and current best_channel selects center, which also fails windows 3-5. However, the predeclared corresponding-channel views explain the failure and a deterministic bounded channel-verification fallback can provisionally recover the stable lag without a spectral representation. Adjudicate that smaller existing-method adjustment first; do not grant automatic authority.

adjudication.smallest_later_adjustment: Separately adjudicate a bounded, fixed-order corresponding-channel verification fallback after mono rejection, retaining one observation per temporal window, requiring cross-view lag agreement, preserving representation-specific scores and contradictions, and remaining provisional-only until lineage-separated positives and negatives calibrate it.
adjudication.reason: Fixed bands and PHAT do not solve waveform confidence, while deterministic corresponding channels expose a mix/rematrix-specific match using existing decode and waveform scoring. Exhaust that bounded existing-method path before adding a new spectral representation.
unchanged_guards: rejected rows not converted to zero

limitations: One private correlated three-source set with zero-frame visual agreement is not general calibration or exact audio-delay ground truth.
The approximately 94-sample candidate is not labeled ground truth; its cause remains unknown.
Direct FL/FR/FC views do not isolate surround-channel phase cancellation, and only the reported rematrix coefficients make rematrix composition a plausible cause.
No lineage-separated real-media negative or known signed-offset set was available, so no new method receives automatic-authority support.
The 65,536-position score-cap result is case-specific; threshold crossings require independent calibration before behavior changes.

Full-overlap scores were measured at candidates selected by the existing path; the requested-rate correction neighborhood was not rerun with full-overlap scoring, so candidate-selection equivalence is unproven.
Activity floors and fixed bands are experiment settings, not production recommendations.
Historical artifact hashes were not reverified because their temporary directory was intentionally deleted after consolidation; they remain retained as prior evidence.
confidence_ablation.disposition: Measurements recorded; current evidence dispositions unchanged; stop before production or fallback implementation.

Cleanup then raised AttributeError while matching the terminate timeout, preventing the production kill fallback from running. Patching only Popen preserves the real exception types; both the direct service and timed orchestration phase cancellation cases now pass.

The same incomplete test-only subprocess proxy omitted TimeoutExpired and prevented the production kill fallback from running. The final fresh image preserves the real subprocess exception types and passes both cancellation cases.

limitations: Synthetic generated containers prove production runtime/resource behavior, not real-media A/V labels.
Sampled RSS is not an OS memory sandbox and cannot exclude a transient between samples.
The separate parent and child sampled peaks are not summed as the combined peak; peak_combined_bytes comes from one combined platform query.

The original macOS/Docker R6 candidate was an explicitly recorded uncommitted evidence worktree; the physical-Windows follow-up instead used exact clean source commit 9c68627423dff9220d65244a142fb4060b2912e4.
The controlled 8/16 kHz result is one real-media case and does not justify changing the default rate or any authority threshold.
Audio evidence cannot independently prove video continuity where audio is silent, identical, or shared across visually different material.
